notes.title: Displacement takeover / Changes / CRACKHEAD is out of development
notes.content:
Dear community,
[url=http://www.displacementstudios.com]Displacement Studios[/url] acquired [i]CRACKHEAD[/i] and the following changes have been performed:
[list]
[*] Linux/SteamOS support
[*] minor performance improvements
[*] corrections in achievements and hardware recommendations
[*] restored the old intro animation
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/696300]soundtrack[/url] expanded to 8 tracks, in total 43 minutes and 5 seconds
[*] added DirectX as dependency
[/list]
[i]CRACKHEAD[/i], the game with the best graphics, is out of development. This does not include bugfixes! There might still be some bugs, please feel free to report any of them to us in the comment section!

notes.title: Update 11/3/2018 NEW GAME ENGINE WOOPS
notes.content:
About update

Well ive been keeping this a secret , Some of you might know of crackheads little sister on steam SMACKHEAD 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/745710/SMACKHEAD/
 SMACKHEAD i made on a newer version of the game making program i used to make CRACKHEAD. After making SMACKHEAD and seen the stability of it i realised i needed to make CRACKHEAD on the new program :)

So over the last few months on and off ive been fiddling with CRACKHEAD on GMS2 which compared to #1 is way more stable for a beautiful game like CRACKHEAD. Now that the game is running on gms2 i believe that the most part of the community will now be able to run the game properly, Further more my code works better and i do believe ive squashed 100% of bugs

 but please if you find anything let me now using forums and i will fix asap 

dont forget to like! CRACKHEAD said it loves you all <3




ABOUT FUTURE UPDATES
Now that CRACKHEAD is moved on to the new game engine i can add lots more and way better effects,
 I will not be editing Overdose mode as that mde is complete.
Not so ez mode will see a huge update over the next month .
 Also the new mode Siezure mode is pretty much ready for release.
 you can expect to see more conent added to level editor.
crackhead is going on nintendo and xbox later this year too.
keep safe

notes.title: CRACKHEAD UPDATE 8/9/2017
notes.content:
This has been by far the hardest update to do and has taken me almost half a year to complete, but finally after some graft and a lot of learning.

  i bring you


"Drum roll please"

CRACKHEAD is now at 60 fps!!! , oh yes it is and the reason its taken so long to finish it is all because all the stuff in game was set to 30 fps or drawn in at 30 fps and i had to individually (600 items) make everything half as slow in a way and that was a lot of items. Anyways done now but if you find anything whizzing around faster then usual don't panic i'll be making sure every thing runs smooth

"runs smooth??"

"drum roll please"

Speaking of running smooth Crackhead just got a huge performance fix making everything run so much smoother then before. Even the ai got 1% better.
oh and we cant forget the graphics of everything are improved, its still 2d and is the same pretty much but everything has been made smooth 
"looks amazing on my widescreen "

theres even more so ill do a list below to wrap this up fast

-Game size now 140mb instead of 350mb
-CRACKHEAD 60fps
-Performance update
-Graphics improved 
-UI Improvements
-Lives gained on level completion increased
-CRACKHEAD THEME TUNE DLC released today (rest of the OST coming)

As usual more will come from stats to steam saves and then ill get the online score up and running again

notes.title: CRACKHEAD UPDATE 11/7/2017
notes.content:
Today i bring the 90% completed version of survival mode. Police blocks are on to your pipe production and are coming for you. You need to eject your head to destroy the police blocks while blocking their projectiles from destroying your pipe, you will get - 10 score per pipe destroyed. Achievement #1 added for this mode. Gain a score of 1000 or more to unlock this achievement.

-Bug fixes and improvements to other modes
-Click to accept button added to epilepsy warning on game start as requested by many players

What you can expect in next update

New mode! Seizure mode is almost complete and i'm sure everyone who likes the overdose mode will love this mode. More visuals and more forced then ever. The full complete versions of i need it easy mode and survival mode will also arrive.
